Many of tonight's ACL 2026 papers turned out to be unusually central to this topic —

once its finding about "Reasoning Solipsism" is read alongside the skeptical papers —
naive parallel exploration fails for the same reason self-revision does elsewhere in this
archive; trained synthesis is what changes that.
